description.en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one and only one; they cannot both be passed through or both be empty.
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported).

description.zh:

* 图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
* 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。

description.en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one and only one; they cannot both be passed through or both be empty.
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.
* When using HTTP invocation, upload the binary image file in the HTTP body.
* When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.

title.zh: 第二类医疗器械经营备案凭证识别
title.en: Recognition of ICP Filing Credential for Class II Medical Devices

descriptions.zh:
#### 本接口适用场景 * 阿里云第二类医疗器械经营备案凭证识别，是阿里云官方自研OCR文字识别产品。适用于识别第二类医疗器械经营备案凭证备案编号、企业名称、经营方式、法定代表人、经营范围等信息的场景。 * 阿里云OCR产品基于阿里巴巴达摩院强大的AI技术及海量数据，历经多年沉淀打磨，具有服务稳定、操作简易、实时性高、能力全面等几大优势。 * 本接口图片示例

#### 本接口核心能力 |分类 |概述| |---|---------| |图像增强|默认支持图像增强，包括图像自动旋转、畸变自动矫正、模糊图片自动增强等能力。| |多类型覆盖|支持模糊、光照不均、透视畸变、任意背景等低质量图像识别。| |高精度识别|总体识别准确率可达98%。| #### 如何使用本接口 |步骤|概述| |--|---| |1|开通 [企业资质识别](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_enterprisecard_public_cn) 服务。开通服务前后，您可以通过[体验馆](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=assets&subtype=c2_medical_device_op_record#intro)免费体验本功能识别效果。| |2|购买 [企业资质识别资源包](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_enterprisecard_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_enterprisecard_dp_cn_20211103184836_0131%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D)。本API会赠送免费额度，可使用免费额度测试。您也可以不购买资源包，系统会通过“[按量付费](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html)”方式按实际调用量自动扣款。| |3|可以参照[调试页面](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeCtwoMedicalDeviceManageLicense?sdkStyle=dara)提供的代码示例完成API接入开发。接入完成后，调用API获取识别结果。如果使用子账号调用接口，需要阿里云账号（主账号）对RAM账号进行授权。创建RAM用户的具体操作，请参考：[创建RAM用户。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html)文字识别服务提供一种系统授权策略，即**AliyunOCRFullAccess**。具体授权操作，请参见[在用户页面为RAM用户授权。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html)| #### 重要提示 |类型|概述| |----|-------------------| |图片格式|
  • 本接口支持：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、TIFF、WebP。暂不支持PDF格式。
| |图片尺寸|
  • 图片长宽需要大于15像素，小于8192像素。
  • 长宽比需要小于50。
  • 如需达到较好识别效果，建议长宽均大于500px。
  • 图片尺寸过小，会影响识别精度。图片内单字大小在10-50px内时，识别效果较好。
| |图片大小|
  • 图片二进制文件不能超过10MB。
  • 图片过大会影响接口响应速度，建议使用小于1.5M图片进行识别，且通过传图片URL的方式调用接口。
|
descriptions.en:
#### Scenarios for This API * The Alibaba Cloud Class II Medical Device Business Filing Certificate Recognition is an OCR product independently developed by Alibaba Cloud. It is suitable for scenarios that require recognition of information such as the filing number, enterprise name, business operation mode, legal representative, and business scope from a Class II medical device business filing certificate. * Based on DAMO Academy's powerful AI technologies and massive data resources, Alibaba Cloud's OCR products have been refined over years of development and offer several key advantages: stable service, ease of use, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API:

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Category | Overview | |---|---------| | Image Enhancement | Supports image enhancement by default, including automatic image rotation, distortion correction, and enhancement of blurry images. | | Coverage of Multiple Types | Supports recognition of low-quality images, including blurry images, images with uneven lighting, perspective distortion, and arbitrary backgrounds. | | High-Accuracy Recognition | Achieves an overall recognition accuracy rate of up to 98%. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [Enterprise Credential Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_enterprisecard_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can experience the recognition capability of this feature for free via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=assets&subtype=c2_medical_device_op_record#intro). | | 2 | Purchase an [Enterprise Credential Recognition resource plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_enterprisecard_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_enterprisecard_dp_cn_20211103184836_0131%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API provides a free quota that you can use for testing. Alternatively, you may choose not to purchase a resource plan; in this case, the system will automatically deduct fees based on your actual usage under the [pay-as-you-go](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html) billing model. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeCtwoMedicalDeviceManageLicense?sdkStyle=dara) to complete API integration. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the classification result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM user](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For details on authorization, see [Grant permissions to a RAM user on the Users page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image Format |
  • This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP formats. PDF format is not currently supported.
| | Image Dimensions |
  • Image height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (height-to-width or width-to-height) must be less than 50.
  • To achieve optimal recognition results, we recommend that both height and width exceed 500 pixels.
  • Images that are too small will negatively impact recognition accuracy. Best results are achieved when individual characters in the image are between 10 and 50 pixels in size.
| | Image File Size |
  • The binary file of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Excessively large images may affect API response speed. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
|
